# Yedric.ai Review

Last modified: |  Fred Magni

 Something in the docs looks wrong. Who do I tell? [...] ## How do I test a change before my users see it?

Use Simulations to run saved scenarios against a change in a sandbox, with pass and fail criteria. Every configuration change is also recorded in Versions, so you can compare any two states and restore an earlier one.

## Why do my Trends charts and my filtered conversation list disagree slightly?

Because they bucket days differently. The date filters on Conversations use your own time zone, while the day buckets on Trends are calculated in UTC. Near the edges of a day the two can differ by a conversation or two. This is expected.

results.title: Yedric.ai: AI Assistant Enhancing SaaS User Experience — Dynamic Business
results.content:
Yedric.ai is an embeddable AI assistant for SaaS and Shopify applications that lets users execute tasks through natural language. Rather than directing users to help articles or support teams, Yedric turns what they say—“change my billing plan,” “fix my broken integration,” or “turn off email notifications”—into actions via APIs or webhooks. This approach is aimed at reducing friction, improving the user experience, and surfacing product insights directly from what users are asking. Yedric is designed to be set up rapidly, configurable, and tightly integrated with a product’s existing documentation, context, and functionality.

## Key Features [...] Configurable permissions per action: Actions exposed via your API can each be set to one of three modes—fully automatic, requiring confirmation (“ask first”), or blocked. This gives teams fine control over what the assistant is allowed to do.

Context-aware behavior: Yedric can use page context, user session details (via JWT, signed sessions, or Shopify sessions), and documentation to understand what the user is doing and where they are in your app. There is also analytics, usage reporting, sentiment and frustration tracking, and conversational dashboards.

Customizable appearance: Branding options include mascot or assistant appearance, look and feel of the assistant widget, tone of voice. You can adjust prompts and behavior depending on where users are in your app. [...] ## Final thoughts

Yedric.ai offers a compelling approach for businesses looking to make their SaaS or Shopify product feel more responsive, intuitive, and useful. By transforming natural language input into actionable results, it reduces the gap between what users want and how they currently interact with product UIs. The free core plan and ability to use your own model keys make it particularly low risk to test. On the other hand, because pricing beyond model usage isn’t detailed publicly, and privacy around end-user data and transcripts is less clearly defined, larger organizations will want to investigate those areas before committing. For its target audience—product teams seeking improved UX and tighter feedback loops—Yedric.ai is a strong contender.
